name: dormitory-management-system
description: Production-ready Dormitory Management System — Decoupled Fullstack Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint --prefix client" "npm run lint --prefix server"
